subject: Delay on my Kuala Lumpur shipment ORD-3001
body: Aisha Rahman writes: my container MSKU123 was supposed to clear Singapore days ago. Order ORD-3001. Can you confirm the new ETA to Kuala Lumpur?

subject: Status check on Rotterdam order ORD-3002
body: Tom Becker asks for a routine status update on order ORD-3002, container MSKU456, heading to Rotterdam. No issues reported on his end.

subject: Missing paperwork for ORD-3003
body: Priya Nair's freight forwarder says container MSKU789 is held in Chicago over a bill of lading mismatch. Order ORD-3003. Needs resolution before Friday.

subject: Damaged goods claim for ORD-3004
body: Carlos Mendes reports container MSKU321 (order ORD-3004) arrived with water damage to the packaged foods inside. Requesting a damage claim and surveyor visit.

subject: Where is my shipment? ORD-3005
body: Grace Kim has heard nothing about container MSKU654 (order ORD-3005) in over a week and is asking whether it is lost. Apparel shipment was time-sensitive for a retail launch.

subject: Delivery confirmation ORD-3006
body: Daniel Osei confirms he received and signed for container MSKU987 (order ORD-3006) on schedule with no exceptions. Just wants a confirmation email for his records.

subject: Air shipment status ORD-3007
body: Fatima Ali asks for a status update on the air waybill AWB-551 (order ORD-3007) carrying medical devices to Doha. Time-sensitive for a hospital delivery window.

subject: Following up again on ORD-3001 delay
body: Aisha Rahman follows up: still no update on MSKU123 since her last email. Asks whether the delay compensation clause in her contract applies.

subject: Can we change the delivery address for ORD-3002?
body: Tom Becker asks whether the destination warehouse for container MSKU456 can be changed mid-transit to a different Rotterdam address.

subject: Fraud tip — suspicious damage photos on ORD-3004
body: Anonymous tip that the water-damage photos submitted for the MSKU321 / ORD-3004 claim may have been reused from an unrelated incident.

subject: Question about delay compensation policy
body: General inquiry, no specific order: what is the compensation policy when an ocean shipment misses its contracted transit time?
